newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan to auction federal investment bonds.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan to auction federal investment bonds.

text.p: The State (central) Bank of Pakistan on Tuesday invited bids for three-, five- and 10-year federal investment bonds.
It said bids should be submitted by Thursday and the auction result would be announced on Sunday and settled on Monday.

In the previous auction on August 27, the central bank accepted bids worth 250 million rupees at par for three-year bonds, 3.5 million rupees at par for five-year bonds and 1.126 billion rupees at par for 10-year bonds.
The bank set no pre-auction target.
